modules.name: Project Delivery & Coordination
modules.description: Coordinate scope, decisions, dependencies, and delivery toward the desired launch window.

tasks.title: Project management and communication
tasks.description: Coordinate planning, stakeholder communication, scope decisions, dependencies, risks, and delivery milestones. Treat the three-month target as a planning goal, not a guaranteed deadline.
tasks.rationale: Cross-cutting coordination is needed to align the many capabilities and resolve unspecified workflows and acceptance criteria.

modules.name: Product Design
modules.description: Define user experience and visual direction for the core product flows.

tasks.title: High-fidelity mockups and component styles
tasks.description: Create high-fidelity mockups and component styles for the agreed core flows, including responsive behavior and reusable UI patterns.
tasks.rationale: Explicitly requested design deliverables provide a basis for implementation; detailed workflows remain to be confirmed.

tasks.title: Clarify workflows and acceptance criteria
tasks.description: Work with stakeholders to define core user journeys, field requirements, dashboard widgets, search filters, reservation rules, and acceptance criteria before implementation.
tasks.rationale: The brief identifies capabilities but lacks detailed workflows and acceptance criteria, creating material design and estimation uncertainty.

modules.name: Platform Foundation
modules.description: Establish application environments, delivery automation, and shared quality practices.

tasks.title: Environment and CI/CD setup
tasks.description: Set up development, test, and production environments, deployment automation, configuration and secrets handling, and baseline operational monitoring using proven technology.
tasks.rationale: A deployable foundation is required to build and release the requested capabilities; no stack or hosting platform is specified.

tasks.title: QA and regression testing
tasks.description: Define a test strategy and execute functional, integration, and regression testing across core flows, APIs, integrations, and supported client platforms.
tasks.rationale: Broad cross-module behavior and integrations require systematic validation; acceptance criteria need to be clarified during delivery.

tasks.title: Code review and engineering quality
tasks.description: Review implementation changes for correctness, maintainability, security, and consistency with agreed architecture and coding standards.
tasks.rationale: Code review is a necessary hidden delivery activity across the implementation, especially for security-sensitive and integration work.

modules.name: Core User Experience
modules.description: Implement the primary application screens and discovery experience.

tasks.title: Core user-flow screens
tasks.description: Implement the agreed core user-flow screens from approved designs, including navigation, responsive layouts, and client-side interaction states. Confirm whether native or cross-platform delivery is intended.
tasks.rationale: Core screens are explicitly requested, but the brief leaves the native versus cross-platform choice and exact flows open.

tasks.title: Search results, filters, sorting, and pagination
tasks.description: Build the search results page with filter controls, sorting, pagination, and appropriate loading, empty, and error states, integrating with the search API.
tasks.rationale: The results experience is explicitly requested and depends on a corresponding backend query contract.

tasks.title: Dashboard widgets and states
tasks.description: Implement the main dashboard with agreed widgets, filters, and empty states, using backend data and approved designs.
tasks.rationale: The dashboard is explicitly requested, while widget definitions and data sources require confirmation.

modules.name: Identity & Access
modules.description: Provide account lifecycle, enterprise sign-in, and access controls.

tasks.title: Registration and account authentication
tasks.description: Implement registration, login, password reset, and email verification flows, including required backend behavior and validation.
tasks.rationale: These account capabilities are explicitly requested and form the foundation for authenticated product use.

tasks.title: Account authentication screens
tasks.description: Implement user-facing registration, login, password reset, and email verification screens and their interaction states.
tasks.rationale: Backend account capabilities require corresponding user-facing flows.

tasks.title: Enterprise SSO integration
tasks.description: Integrate login with the client's identity provider, including configuration, authentication flow, and account mapping. Confirm provider and protocol during discovery.
tasks.rationale: SSO is explicitly requested, but the identity provider and integration details are unspecified.

modules.name: Business APIs & Availability
modules.description: Expose validated business-entity APIs and support availability and reservations.

tasks.title: Business entity REST endpoints
tasks.description: Design and implement REST endpoints for the agreed main business entities, including request validation and consistent error responses.
tasks.rationale: The API capability is explicit, but the entity list and detailed contracts are not provided.

tasks.title: Availability and reservation services
tasks.description: Implement availability rules, reservation creation and updates, and conflict handling. Define rule semantics and concurrency expectations with stakeholders.
tasks.rationale: Availability and conflict handling are explicitly requested, but business rules and edge cases are unspecified.

modules.name: Search & Location
modules.description: Support location-aware discovery and map-based presentation.

tasks.title: Geocoding and distance services
tasks.description: Integrate geocoding and implement distance calculations for the agreed location use cases, including handling invalid or unavailable location data.
tasks.rationale: Geocoding and distance calculations are explicit capabilities; provider, units, and data requirements remain open.

tasks.title: Map display
tasks.description: Implement map presentation for relevant product flows, including markers or other agreed location indicators and integration with location data.
tasks.rationale: Map display is explicitly requested and depends on location services and a selected map provider.

tasks.title: Search query and pagination API
tasks.description: Implement backend search queries supporting the agreed filters, sorting, and pagination required by the results page.
tasks.rationale: The requested search interface needs a backend query capability; searchable fields and filter semantics are not specified.

modules.name: Document & Image Intelligence
modules.description: Extract information from scanned documents and classify uploaded images.

tasks.title: OCR field extraction
tasks.description: Implement OCR processing for scanned documents and extract the agreed fields, with a strategy for low-confidence results and processing failures.
tasks.rationale: OCR and field extraction are explicit, but document types, fields, accuracy targets, and review workflows are unknown.

tasks.title: Image classification model
tasks.description: Evaluate and integrate or train a computer-vision model to classify uploaded images, including defining labels, evaluation criteria, and inference behavior.
tasks.rationale: The requirement permits either training or integration, but provides no label set, dataset, accuracy target, or volume assumptions.

modules.name: ERP Integration
modules.description: Exchange order and stock data with the client's ERP system.

tasks.title: ERP order export and stock import
tasks.description: Integrate with the ERP to export orders and import stock levels, including mapping, error handling, and reconciliation behavior. Confirm ERP product and interface details.
tasks.rationale: Both directions of data exchange are explicit, but the ERP, protocols, schemas, and synchronization expectations are unspecified.

modules.name: Privacy & Security
modules.description: Support privacy requests and apply security controls and review.

tasks.title: Consent and data subject requests
tasks.description: Implement consent management and workflows to process data export and deletion requests, including tracking request status and handling applicable data dependencies.
tasks.rationale: These privacy capabilities are explicit, but consent categories, retention rules, and applicable regulatory obligations are not specified.

tasks.title: OWASP review and security controls
tasks.description: Conduct an OWASP-focused application security review and implement rate limiting and audit logging for agreed sensitive actions and endpoints.
tasks.rationale: The review and controls are explicitly requested; scope and audit event requirements need to be established during implementation.
